stem: In a city, the average cost of electricity is $0.12 per kilowatt-hour. Which graph best represents this relationship?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph showing a very gradual increase in cost from 0 to about 1.5 dollars at 12 kilowatt-hours

options.label: B
options.text: Graph showing an increase in cost to about 1.2 dollars at 12 kilowatt-hours

options.label: C
options.text: Graph showing a linear increase where cost reaches 12 dollars at 12 kilowatt-hours

options.label: D
options.text: Graph showing a steep increase in cost to 12 dollars at 1 kilowatt-hour

visual_elements: Graph A: labeled 'Electricity Cost' y-axis 0 to 12 dollars, x-axis 0 to 12 kilowatt-hours, line very shallow upward
Graph B: labeled 'Electricity Cost' y-axis 0 to 12 dollars, x-axis 0 to 12 kilowatt-hours, line slightly steeper ending near 1.2 dollars
Graph C: labeled 'Electricity Cost' y-axis 0 to 12 dollars, x-axis 0 to 12 kilowatt-hours, line linear ending at 12 dollars at 12 kWh
Graph D: labeled 'Electricity Cost' y-axis 0 to 12 dollars, x-axis 0 to 12 kilowatt-hours, line steep ending at 12 dollars at 1 kWh
